required_evidence.source: AGENTS.md §1 (actual-run rule: §1.4 vm-target test / topology test chain, §1.5 frozen candidate) and docs/actual-run-evidence.md
required_evidence.description: Candidate-bound target run (syntax, check/diff, apply, spec verify, second apply changed=0, plus the failure paths the change touches) on a disposable vm-target/docker-target, with the sanitized summary committed as docs/evidence/<feature>/<date>-<tested-revision>.md. Required for any change to playbooks, specs, contracts, inventory handling or deploy orchestration; not-applicable, with the reason, for docs/skill-only changes or pure Go changes proven by native-tool tests.
